description: Quote envelope digests and their target derivations. quote_envelope_digest(network, manifest_hash, reason, role, target) = tagged_hash(["spark","quote","v1"]) over uint64 network, 32-byte manifest_hash, uint64 reason, uint64 role, then the target bytes. Each target has its own tag: receive_attestor_target(payment_hash), send_target(payment_hash), coop_exit_target(withdrawal_address, leaf_set_hash), static_deposit_target(txid, vout). Two implementations are held to these vectors: common/quote_envelope.go (native, the SO links no Rust) and signer/spark-token-primitives/src/quote_envelope.rs (the shared core). THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH: a rule change must land in both and re-mint this file. COVERAGE IS ASYMMETRIC BY DESIGN: the Rust core implements all four targets; the Go port implements only receive_attestor_target, which is the only one the operators verify, and asserts only those vectors. `reasons` and `roles` pin the name-to-number mapping, which each implementation asserts against its own named constants — the digests alone cannot catch a renumbering. network values are the spark proto Network enum (MAINNET=1, REGTEST=2, TESTNET=3, SIGNET=4); UNSPECIFIED=0 is refused. An ISSUER may sign an empty target (at quote time there is nothing else to bind); an ATTESTOR may not.

testCases.name: receive_issuer_mainnet
testCases.description: The issuer's inputs carrying a target, so its pair with role_swap_differs varies nothing but the role

testCases.name: receive_attestor_mainnet
testCases.description: The preimage-share owner at commit time, binding the invoice it settles

testCases.name: receive_attestor_regtest
testCases.description: Same role on another network: the network component must move the digest

testCases.name: receive_attestor_zero_hashes
testCases.description: All-zero hashes: hashstructure is length-prefixed, not zero-eliding, so an objecthash-style implementation that omits empty fields diverges here

testCases.name: role_swap_differs
testCases.description: receive_issuer_mainnet's inputs with only the role changed, holding a non-empty target constant so the pair isolates `role` alone

testCases.name: send_issuer_mainnet
testCases.description: receive_issuer_mainnet with only the reason changed; proves appending role did not collide the reason and role byte positions

testCases.name: coop_exit_issuer_mainnet
testCases.description: Pins REASON_COOP_EXIT = 3 by hash, not only by the reasons map

testCases.name: static_deposit_issuer_mainnet
testCases.description: Pins REASON_STATIC_DEPOSIT = 4 by hash, not only by the reasons map

testCases.name: receive_issuer_testnet
testCases.description: Pins the accepted-network range at TESTNET=3; without it a port could narrow the range and stay green

testCases.name: receive_issuer_signet
testCases.description: Pins the top of the accepted-network range at SIGNET=4

testCases.name: receive_issuer_empty_target
testCases.description: The SSP at quote time: no invoice exists yet, so the issuer's target is empty. This is the shape P3 sends once sparkcore routes its issuer digest through the core.

distinctDigestPairs.name: role_separation
distinctDigestPairs.description: Identical inputs under different roles must not share a digest

distinctDigestPairs.name: reason_separation
distinctDigestPairs.description: Identical inputs under different reasons must not share a digest

distinctDigestPairs.name: reason_separation_upper
distinctDigestPairs.description: The two later reasons must separate from each other too

distinctDigestPairs.name: network_separation
distinctDigestPairs.description: Identical inputs on different networks must not share a digest, so every enum component in the envelope has a pair

invalidCases.name: network_unspecified
invalidCases.description: Network 0 is the unset sentinel; accepting it would collapse every network onto one digest and defeat the component

invalidCases.name: network_out_of_range
invalidCases.description: Network above the last defined network

invalidCases.name: reason_unset
invalidCases.description: Reason 0 is the unset sentinel, never a signable flow

invalidCases.name: reason_out_of_range
invalidCases.description: Reason above the last defined flow

invalidCases.name: role_unset
invalidCases.description: Role 0 is the unset sentinel, never a signing party

invalidCases.name: role_out_of_range
invalidCases.description: Role above the last defined party

invalidCases.name: network_high_bits_alias_mainnet
invalidCases.description: 2^32+1 truncates to MAINNET in a 32-bit lookup while the full width is what gets hashed, so a guard that casts before bounding accepts a network it never validated

invalidCases.name: network_high_bits_alias_unspecified
invalidCases.description: 2^32 truncates to UNSPECIFIED, whose name IS in the descriptor, so a truncating guard admits the one value the unspecified case exists to refuse

invalidCases.name: attestor_empty_target
invalidCases.description: An attestor signs at commit time, when the payment hash exists, so an empty target is a caller that dropped the binding rather than one with nothing to bind

targetCases.name: receive_attestor
targetCases.description: The only target the operators verify, hence the only one the Go port implements

targetCases.name: send
targetCases.description: Matches sparkcore's pinned c0d8ef2f... for this input

targetCases.name: coop_exit_valid_lowercase
targetCases.description: A valid segwit address canonicalizes to itself

targetCases.name: coop_exit_valid_uppercase
targetCases.description: MUST equal coop_exit_valid_lowercase. Bech32 is case-insensitive (BIP-173), so equivalent-case renderings of one address must hash identically at quote and at commit. This is the only test of the lowercasing branch in any port.

targetCases.name: coop_exit_mixed_case_verbatim
targetCases.description: Mixed case is refused by the segwit validator, so the address is bound verbatim rather than lowercased — a port that lowercases unconditionally diverges here

targetCases.name: coop_exit_base58_verbatim
targetCases.description: Base58 is case-sensitive, so a non-segwit address is bound exactly as given

targetCases.name: coop_exit_bad_checksum_verbatim
targetCases.description: An invalid checksum is not a segwit address, so it is bound verbatim

targetCases.name: static_deposit
targetCases.description: Matches sparkcore's pinned c55b021c... for this input. vout is bounded to uint32 but committed as a uint64 — the width in the stream is not the width of the bound.
